_about: Tour suggestions – every number the method uses, read again on each request. Nothing here is per region: what is good is measured against the place itself (place.py). docs/design/tour-suggestions.md explains the method.

activities._about: wild = where the activity (and for hikes the T level) sits on the character scale 0 gemütlich … 1 wild. profile = the app's BRouter profile. pace = km/h on the flat (turns the wished time into distance; not asked from the person).

family._about: What differs between going on foot and on wheels. ground = how welcome [paved, firm, natural, rough] ground is at the gemütlich and the wild end. up_m_per_h = metres of ascent per hour up to which a tour is usual at the gemütlich and the wild end: when no ascent range is wished it is 0 … this x the longest wished time. ascent_m_per_h = time model: hours = km / pace + ascent / this. band_km = a single wished time is widened by this many kilometres either way to a range. free_stem_m = a way out and back this long costs nothing. road_walk_max_m = longest stretch along a road with cars outside a town (0 = no limit). road_repair_m = a loop with a longer stretch along such a road is built once more with those ways search.road_repair times dearer (wheels since 2026-11-17: not a limit, the way without the road mostly exists). reach_max_m / coarse = how much way network is loaded (wheels: minor ways left out unless a signed route runs on them). sectors / pairs / chains / lines = how many loops each generator tries; few = when fewer loops than this are built, the turning points are tried again in twice as many directions and at three times across the wished range.

character._about: Level 3 – what this person wants, from gemütlich to wild (linear in between). axes = weight of the five axes. depth = how much of Natur is being deep inside nature rather than green beside the way. signed = how much a signed route counts as something special. path = on foot, the share of Weg that is the width of the way – a narrow path rather than a wide track (quality trails: Deutsches Wanderinstitut 'Wegeformat', Wanderverband 'Pfade'; quality.width).

aims._about: Aims – what a loop can lead to, as turning points (generate.aims), and the wish's Ziel (owner 2026-11-17: Gipfel · Wasser · Aussicht · Einkehr · Kultur, several, none = the finest in reach). kinds = which map things belong to a Ziel. worth = how much reaching one counts, by kind (none chosen: all count by this). reach_m = a loop reaches an aim when it passes this near (a peak also no more than peak_below metres lower than its height); a lake is reached when the loop runs within shore_near metres along lake_min of its shore (or lake_min_m of a big one) and shore_m along its ways; along one side counts half, gone round (round of it) full. reached = raw Besonderes per aim reached x its worth (at most most), chosen = factor on that for an aim of a chosen Ziel; weight = factor on the Besonderes weight when a Ziel is chosen. Einkehr counts full in the middle of the loop, nothing at its ends. shore = cost factor on a lake's shore while a loop aims at it (go round, or one side there and the other back). candidates = how many aims per wish become turning points (alone, with a turning point a quarter turn away, two aims in a chain), chosen ones on top up to chosen_candidates.

facts._about: Level 1 – thresholds that turn tags and map into facts, the same everywhere. road = how much a road class counts as 'with cars'; calm = factor at 30 km/h; beside = a separate way right beside a road counts this share of it; beside_from = roads from this weight on count for 'beside'; big_water = share of open water within 300 m from which a bank is big water; rank = signed route networks. rim = [from, full, reach]: a way is at an edge with a view where the ground 90 m … reach metres away on one side lies on average from (0) … full (1) metres lower, times how open (not under trees) that side is.

quality._about: What German quality trails measure and our axes did not (Deutscher Wanderverband 'Qualitätsweg', Deutsches Wanderinstitut 'Premiumweg'; docs/design/tour-suggestions.md §3). width = how welcome a way's width is on foot: a narrow path (highway path / footway / steps / bridleway, not paved), a track (grade 1 / 2, else rough), a road or wide made way. variety = landscape changes along the loop (forest / open land / water / village, by the dominant kind of each step_m stretch): full at per_km changes per km (Wanderverband: one per 2–3 km, Wanderinstitut: two within 6 km); Natur counts (1 - share) + share x variety.

place._about: Level 2 – the place as the yardstick. A value is poor at the `low` quantile of the ways in reach and full at the `high` one (at least min_span apart). standout = the best share of the ground here: connected it forms the areas and lines the loops aim at; an area counts from min_area x the wished length. access_built = the way out ends where less than this share of the ways runs through houses; access_max = at most this share of the wished length counts as the unavoidable way out. rim / sight = what an edge with a view (facts rim, 0..1) and a way at a sight are worth on Besonderes; rim_natur = on Natur (an open edge with a view is not 'out of the forest'); water_natur = a way at water outside settlements counts this much as nature (x the water fact: big water 1, small 0.5) – quality trails count shores like forest margins (2026-11-17: the Lautersee / Ferchensee loops lost on Natur for leaving the forest for the lakes). top = per axis the quantile of the ways beyond the way out at which a loop counts full (100): a loop is judged on the place alone, never against the other loops (2026-11-16); Natur lower, since a loop's mean over mixed ways rarely reaches the very best; Besonderes gets form.ring on top (room for going round a signed loop).

search._about: How the cheapest way is found: metres x (1 + taste x (1 - how good the way is here)) x (1 + road x traffic). used = factor on a way already in the loop, beside_used = on ways touching it (keeps the way home apart, so nothing is doubled or crossed), line = factor on the ways of a line that is being followed. radius = network loaded around the start, as a share of the wished length. road_repair = on foot, a loop with a longer stretch along a road than allowed is built once more with such ways this many times dearer. climb = when no loop stays below a wished maximum of ascent that is lower than usual for the time, the loops are built once more with each metre up or down costing this x (1 - maximum / usual) x the flat metres the time model gives a metre up (always on, it made the comparison sets worse).

form._about: The Form axis and the few hard rules. Inside the wished ranges of time and ascent every loop is equally fine. short_zero = share below the shortest wished time at which the time part is 0; long_zero = share above the longest from which a loop is no longer offered; under the wished ascent the part falls gently, above it the loop is not offered. doubled_zero = share walked twice (beyond the free stem) at which that part is 0. cross = factor for one meeting with the own way; max_cross = more meetings than this are never offered. sight = bonus on Besonderes per sight passed (viewpoint, castle, ruin, chapel, cave, waterfall; at most 3). ring = bonus on Besonderes for walking a signed circular route round (ours, origin Rundweg, and an official loop itself: what the place's makers laid out) – only while its longest stretch along a road with cars stays within ring_road_m (along a road is always bad; on foot longer is out anyway). When no loop stays below the wished maximum of ascent (a hard limit, for official loops too), the flattest are shown with a clear hint: those within steep_share x the least ascent found, at most steep_cards.

select._about: One selection over all cards: our loops and the official loops near the start that fit the wish (the page). max cards; no two may share more than `overlap` of the shorter one's way (beyond the common way out); a further one must not be more than `behind` points below the first; what stands out in reach (a top line such as the river with 'am Wasser entlang', an area) gets one card if its best loop is within cover_behind points; official_ahead = points an official loop gets in the selection only (between two similar loops the official one wins unless clearly worse); while fewer than `least` are shown, further different loops may be up to least_behind points below the first.
